identity.name: Prospex Marine Master 300 — 1968 Reinterpretation
identity.one_liner: A blue-dial continuation of the Marine Master 300 lineage, hand-assembled on caliber 8L35 using techniques shared with Grand Seiko's 9S movements.

provenance_events.description: The SLA023 is the 2020 reinterpretation of the 1968 62.5-600 Marine Master — a 44mm titanium-cased diver with a ceramic bezel, sold at 1,968-piece limited release worldwide.

narrative.story: The SLA023 continues the Marine Master 300 lineage that traces back to Seiko's 1968 professional diver, running caliber 8L35 — a manually assembled, 192-part automatic built at the Shizukuishi Watch Studio using techniques shared with Grand Seiko's caliber 9S. It uses a monobloc case with no separate caseback, the movement accessed through the crystal, paired with a ceramic 120-click bezel and 300m water resistance. Seiko finished it in a blue sunburst dial rather than the black dial of the original 1968 reference.
narrative.collector_notes: Currently shown as sold out at multiple authorized dealers rather than formally discontinued by Seiko; confirm current availability before assuming it's off the market for good.
